source: segmentation (internet footage, background replaced by white; 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' label bottom-right)
scene_type: 2D (top-down view of a table, camera looking straight down)
units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed
duplicated_frames_note: each listed frame is an exact repeat of the previous one (source frame rate lower than 24, ~37 unique frames); one-frame differences are 0 there and doubled at the next frame

camera.description: handheld top-down camera drifting slowly: whole image moves up ~25-28 px (frames 0-28), partly back, small rotation up to 0.8 deg and scale 0.994-1.0005. Per-frame similarity transform frame0->frame i in tracks/camera_shift.csv; *_stab columns in the tracks are positions mapped back into the frame-0 image (background-stabilised).
camera.perspective: near-orthographic top-down; pizza appears as an ellipse 472 x 441 px (horizontal axis longer, ratio 0.935) so the view is slightly oblique or the pizza slightly oval; no horizon

objects.name: pizza_cutter
objects.description: rolling pizza cutter (metal wheel, black plastic guard and handle) held in the right hand; the only object that moves relative to the table
objects.reference_points: front = upper-left end of the black guard (wheel hub side, always visible); cx,cy = centroid of the visible black-plastic blob (biased while the hand covers the guard, frames 0-34)

pixel_size.note: wheel and handle only fully seen in frames 45-47 when the cutter is lifted and tilted; manual estimates +-5 px

motion_summary_px.cut_stroke: frames 0-36, straight diagonal from upper-left to lower-right, direction ~40 deg below +x (image y down)
motion_summary_px.after_stop: frames 37-44 small drift up-right, 2-5 px per frame; frames 45-47 cutter lifted and turned toward the camera

objects.name: cutting_hand
objects.description: right hand + forearm in white sleeve entering from the right, holding the cutter; moves with the cutter (no separate track; use pizza_cutter)

objects.name: pizza
objects.description: large round pepperoni pizza in the image centre; static on the table (moves only with the camera)

objects.name: holding_hand_bottom
objects.description: second person's/left hand fingertips at the bottom edge of the pizza (x 570-710, y 590-674), steadying the pizza; moves only with the camera

objects.name: wine_glass
objects.description: stemmed glass of red wine lying/tilted at top-left

objects.name: monopoly_money
objects.description: stack of yellow Monopoly banknotes right of the pizza: top 500 note upside-down, a rotated 500 note, a 100 note below

objects.name: monopoly_board
objects.description: Monopoly board, top-right corner region, rotated ~-30 deg, with orange Chance cards (~130 x 100 px stack at ~950-1095, 25-160), green houses, a ring token, train icon
objects.pixel_extent_f0: board+money cluster bbox [865, 0, 1279, 409]; board continues off-frame

events.event: video starts with the cutter already rolling through the pizza
cut stroke ends (cutter reaches the lower-right crust near the cutting hand)
cutter direction reverses: small up-right drift
cutter lifted and turned (wheel face becomes visible)
